nodes.label: Module 2: UFW firewall (deny incoming, allow SSH/HTTP/HTTPS)
nodes.norm_label: module 2: ufw firewall (deny incoming, allow ssh/http/https)

nodes.label: Module 3: Fail2ban - block IPs after failed logins
nodes.norm_label: module 3: fail2ban - block ips after failed logins

nodes.label: Module 4: SSH port change with validation
nodes.norm_label: module 4: ssh port change with validation

nodes.label: Module 5: SSH keys - key-based auth and hardened settings
nodes.norm_label: module 5: ssh keys - key-based auth and hardened settings

nodes.label: Module 7: SSH audit - CVE checks (Terrapin, regreSSHion) and weak ciphers
nodes.norm_label: module 7: ssh audit - cve checks (terrapin, regresshion) and weak ciphers

nodes.label: Module 10: Block root - disable password login for root
nodes.norm_label: module 10: block root - disable password login for root

nodes.label: Dry-run demo mode (--dry-run)
nodes.rationale: Let users preview exactly what would be changed without modifying the system, eliminating risk on first run

nodes.label: Error handling (retry/skip/back-to-menu/exit)
nodes.rationale: On any error offer retry/skip/menu/exit so a single failure never aborts the whole run and the admin keeps control

nodes.label: Input validation (names, ports, email)
nodes.rationale: Validate all user input up front to prevent misconfiguration breaking SSH access

nodes.label: Automatic backups before each change
nodes.rationale: Backup before every modification makes all changes reversible and is the foundation of the rollback feature

nodes.label: Full rollback (--rollback)
nodes.rationale: Allow complete reversal of all changes from backups, including from a specific backup path, so failures are never permanent

nodes.label: Logging to /var/log/vps-security-*.log
nodes.rationale: Every action is logged for auditability and debugging of what the script changed

nodes.label: Email notifications (AIDE and rkhunter reports)
nodes.rationale: AIDE and rkhunter reports are emailed so the admin is alerted to integrity or rootkit events without needing to log in

nodes.label: Full Russian localization
nodes.rationale: All dialogs and messages are in Russian to make the tool accessible to Russian-speaking admins
